_comment: Monitored-resource descriptors: resource.type -> its EXACT label key set.
Restated from the public Cloud Logging resource list
against the descriptor registry as recorded in LOGENTRY_SPEC.md section 5.
Emitting a label key that is not in the descriptor's set is the single
highest-risk fidelity defect in synthetic Cloud Logging data: a hostname
in gce_instance.resource.labels instead of top-level labels is the

prometheus_target.note: Managed Prometheus target resource. Its six labels are attached by the GMP collector at export time and MUST NOT appear as exporter-emitted metric labels (PROMETHEUS_SPEC.md section 2.2).
